title: Add support for SDL3 joystick input driver for Android, iOS, visionOS and Web
body:
Follow-up to https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/106218 Closes https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/47656 Closes https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/96985 This PR adds support for SDL joystick input for the rest of the platforms Godot Engine supports. Previously it was only available on desktop platforms (Windows, Linux and macOS). I also decided to refactor `joypad_sdl.cpp` a little bit and add joystick vibration feature to the web platform in this PR :D I have tested this PR on Android and web, I haven't tested it on iOS and visionOS, but judging by how SDL input was integrated on macOS I hope this approach works for iOS and visionOS too. I haven't made Android use HIDAPI yet (which was used for new joypad features in my other PR: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/107967 ), I'm not sure I can, because I'm not an Android developer and it was tiring to make SDL's Android Java code work properly in Godot's build system 😅 (EDIT: It can't be done properly: https://github.com/libsdl-org/SDL/commit/e3cf2e479498205cec56906e03800da24e38786b https://github.com/libsdl-org/SDL/blob/main/src/hidapi/android/hid.cpp#L1052 ) This PR also fixes 3 issues on Android (tested with my DualShock 4 on the master branch using [this script](https://gist.github.com/anthonyec/5342fce79b2b7b22ada748df0ad7f7c0)):
1. Trigger axes values were not reset after the user stops pressing on them; I'm not pressing any buttons on the screenshot: Relevant issues https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/79263 https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/108982 The same situation after my PR:
2. Pressing the left trigger caused the Share button (or JoyButton::BACK) to be pressed as well; I'm only pressing the left and right triggers on the screenshot: Pressing Share on the controller didn't trigger anything, but after releasing the left trigger the BACK button stopped being red. After my PR Godot can properly detect the Share button being pressed:
3. Fingerpring scanners were recognized as joypads. Relevant issue: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/47656 Before my PR: After my PR:
There's also another Android issue ( https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/56181 ), but I can't reproduce it on master with my DualShock 4, so I can't test if it was fixed by my PR. ~~There's another problem, I haven't tested it on master yet but after this PR the joypad triggers are now digital (just 0.0 or 1.0) on web~~ (EDIT: I hope it's now fixed), related SDL issue: https://github.com/libsdl-org/SDL/issues/13051 Old TODO: - [x] Make a pull request for web joystick vibration for SDL repository ( https://github.com/libsdl-org/SDL/pull/13757 ) - [x] Make a pull request for SDL to fix Android joystick implementation not calling `SDL_ShouldIgnoreJoystick` to ignore unnecessary gamepads ( https://github.com/libsdl-org/SDL/pull/13759 ) - [x] Web: analog triggers - [x] Web: proper joypad names - [x] Web: DualSense on Firefox works very badly, I'm not sure it's fixable in Godot, maybe it shouldn't be detected at all? - [x] SDL: Make a PR for web joysticks to get vendor and product IDs when possible + use them in GUIDs? (see https://stackoverflow.com/questions/66885705/how-to-get-vendor-and-productid-of-joystick-device-with-javascript and https://gist.github.com/Enichan/de1618d2c481523bd0c1123800bfe747 ) ( https://github.com/libsdl-org/SDL/pull/14003 ) - [x] iOS: Undefined haptic symbols problem - [x] Android: fix crash - https://gist.github.com/bruvzg/9822262842e885170289d40572fc4002 TODO for separate PRs: - [ ] Windows: Move joypad code to OS_Windows class (it should probably happen after we update to newer version of SDL, since currently SDL needs HWND of a helper window for DirectInput controllers, it's fixed in newer versions of SDL) - [ ] SDL joypad process and deinitialization macros - [ ] After https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/108214 is merged: `Input.get_joy_info()` fields for new platforms - [ ] Remove Godot's mapping system code? TODO for Android: - [ ] Android: find a way to use SDLSurface.java file's input events to be more stable - [ ] Check if this issue is fixed on Android: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/73446 - [ ] Check if this PR works on Android: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/109750 - [ ] Check for regressions for fixes in this PR: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/106021 (I currently don't have access to an Xbox controller, so I can't test this myself) TODO for splitting: - [ ] PR for Android - [x] PR for iOS/visionOS ( https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/114316 ) - [x] PR for web ( https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/114318 )
